note.zh-TW: 本課照課程從稅前淨利起算；若從本期淨利起算，要另外加回所得稅費用。IFRS 18 修正 IAS 7 後，間接法改由營業損益起算（國際上自 {{raw:2027}} 年起生效，台灣自 {{raw:2028}} 會計年度起適用；查證於 {{raw:2026-10-24}}）。
note.en: The indirect method here starts from this line, as the course does; starting from profit for the period instead means adding income tax expense back separately. After the IFRS 18 amendments to IAS 7 the indirect method starts from operating profit or loss instead (effective internationally from {{raw:2027}} and applied in Taiwan from the {{raw:2028}} financial year; checked on {{raw:2026-10-24}}).

definition.zh-TW: 經常利益再加減非常損益之後、還沒扣所得稅費用的獲利，是五層利益的第四層。網站的間接法從這個數字起算，所得稅改在營業活動的支付所得稅(-) 以實付金額扣除，所以現金流量表起算列的金額必須和損益表的稅前淨利相同，這就是步驟②（勾稽點 A）。
definition.en: The profit left once extraordinary items have been added to or deducted from ordinary profit, before income tax expense; the fourth of the five profit levels. The site’s indirect method starts from this figure and deducts the tax actually paid on the income taxes paid (-) line in operating activities, so the starting line of the statement of cash flows must match profit before tax on the income statement: that is step 2 (check A).
